'''Jerris Rez''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] living during the [[Galactic War]] who worked as an arms dealer for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]]. He set up shop in the [[Labor Valley]] and began to supply military-grade ordnance and other weapons to [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Tradik]], but when his supplies were sabotaged by the local rebels, he asked an Imperial hero to deal with them and resume the weapon supply line.
